title: Checking the finished resume
description: The completeness of the text, the reading order and the page boundaries are checked before sending.

blocks.text: Once the resume is filled in the person expects a finished file. In the example given they didn’t even get that; other complaints in the breakdown describe trimmed text and a format that wasn’t accepted. A check should start with opening the result, and then move on to the content and the reading order.

quote.text: I've built a resume and selected download. I get a “generating PDF” but the resume disappears. It's not in my files folder. I've already paid for the app and wish I didn't.

blocks.text: Open the final file in a preview, compare what it contains with the text that can be extracted. Point to the particular places that need fixing.
Don’t promise to get through every screening system. The technical readability of a file and an employer’s judgment of a candidate are different things.
